props.title: Quick Check: Net Revenue Retention
props.question: Based on our bridge, what is our Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate for this quarter?

options.feedback: Correct! NRR is calculated as (Starting ARR + Expansion - Churn) / Starting ARR. Here, (12.4 + 1.3 - 0.5) / 12.4 = 106.45%, which rounds to 106.5% if excluding new business, but with new business included, total growth is 121.8%.

props.explanation: Net Revenue Retention measures the change in existing customer revenue. Excluding new business ($1.9M), our base went from $12.4M to $13.2M ($12.4M + $1.3M - $0.5M), resulting in a 106.5% NRR.
